en.title: Server firsts at a glance
items: Records with many steps, like career goals and legend score, now sit on one line with the highest step and the next goal.
The players who set the most records this season show above the recent records.

items: 通算ゴールやレジェンドスコアのように段階が続く記録を1行にまとめました。最も高い段階と次の目標が表示されます。
